profile.main_gun_source: American Fleets A-4（炮座/口径文本）；CAS Annex C 的 Mk7 16in/50 弹道行未在本工作区已核数据中定位。
profile.sensors: SK, 2 SG radars (IA, NJ, WI); SK-2, 2 SG radars (MO)
profile.remarks_verbatim: Iowa, New Jersey, Missouri, Wisconsin. MO and WI completed with Mk12/22 fire control radars for 5 in vice Mk4. Additional units Illinois and Kentucky never completed.
dated_remarks: 1945: Iowa had Mk4 replaced by Mk12/22, SK-2, SC-2, SU radars added.
1945: New Jersey had Mk4 replaced by Mk12/22, SK-2, SP radars added.
1945: Wisconsin fitted with SP, SC-2 radars.
Aug 45: Illinois canceled.
Jun 50: Work stopped on Kentucky, scrapped Jun 58.
Post-1953: Search radars replaced by SPS-12 air search and SPS-10 surface search; Mk12/22 replaced by Mk25.

shipdef_blockers: CAS Annex C 的 Mk8 12in/50 弹道行未在本工作区已核数据中定位；American Fleets A-12 只给炮座/口径文本，不能补 range_yd/damage/pen，未用近似值或其它舰炮行替代。

profile.main_gun_source: American Fleets A-12（炮座/口径文本）；CAS Annex C 的 Mk8 12in/50 弹道行未在本工作区已核数据中定位。
profile.remarks_verbatim: Alaska, Guam. Additional unit Hawaii started with Aug 45 AA fit, but retained incomplete after 1945. Philippines, Puerto Rico and Samoa cancelled. Mk12/22 have F/A arcs.
dated_remarks: Jan 45: Proposed Light AA to (4)15 40mm, (2)2 40mm, (1)30 20mm, Lt AA 23.5. None fitted.
Aug 45: Proposed Light AA to (4)15 40mm, (2)4 40mm, (2)24 20mm, Lt AA 29.0.

shipdef_blockers: CAS Annex C 的 Mk16 8in/55 弹道行未在本工作区已核数据中定位；American Fleets A-12 只给炮座/口径文本，不能补 range_yd/damage/pen，未用近似值或其它舰炮行替代。
本级 1948 年才服役；ERMA 扩想定把 1948 配置放进 1944 年，属架空，不能当作 1944 年历史舰卡。

profile.scenario_fit_note: 1948 年服役配置；ERMA 扩想定设定为 1944 年第二次马里亚纳海战，属架空，不是 1944 年历史配置。
profile.main_gun_source: American Fleets A-12（炮座/口径文本）；CAS Annex C 的 Mk16 8in/55 弹道行未在本工作区已核数据中定位。
profile.remarks_verbatim: Des Moines, Newport News, Salem. Nine other planned units canceled, included CA-140 Dallas (scrapped incomplete), CA 141 - 143, CA 149 - 153. Designed for (4)12 40mm, 20 20mm, but completed with 12 twin 20mm. In peacetime usually carried only 7 (F/2P/2S/PA/SA, Area AA 7.3) or 8 (3P/3S/PA/SA, Area AA 7.9) twin 3 inch.
dated_remarks: Early 1950s: 20mm removed, catapults and aircraft removed.
Post-1953: Search radars replaced by SPS-12 air search and SPS-8A surface search; Mk12/22 replaced by Mk25.
1955: Forward most twin 3 in permanently removed, Area AA 6.7.
1962: Newport News rebuilt as flagship. Two midships 3 inch mounts removed, Area AA 6.7.
1966: Newport News 3 inch fit P/S/PA/SA(2)4, Area AA 5.6.
1973: Newport News 3 inch fit PA/SA(2)2, Area AA 4.5.
Decommissioned: Salem 1959, Des Moines 1961, Newport News 1975.

profile.scenario_fit_note: 1948 年服役配置；ERMA 扩想定设定为 1944 年第二次马里亚纳海战，属架空，不是 1944 年历史配置。
profile.remarks_verbatim: Worcester, Roanoke. Two additional planned units canceled. Planned Lt AA fit (4)11 and (2)2 40mm, 20 20mm, changed to 3 inch in before completion. Each 6 in mount had its own Mk27 radar rangefinder instead of an optical rangefinder (modifier for local control -1, instead of -2).

profile.torpedoes_verbatim: P&S(5)2 Mk14, Mk15 533mm TT w/5 Mk15 torpedoes
profile.asw: 2 Mk9 DC rail w/8 Mk7 or 12 Mk6/9 DC; 6 Mk6 K-gun w/4 Mk6/9 DC
profile.remarks_verbatim: DD 692-709, 722-734, 741, 744-748, 752-762, 770, 774-781, 857 (DD 760-762 were commissioned post-war). Total of 23 Mk7 & 16 Mk6 or 41 Mk6/9 DCs carried.
dated_remarks: Apr 43: (2)2 40mm and single 20mm added, Lt AA 7.0.
Later: (2)2 40mms replaced by (4)2 40mm, Lt AA 8.0.
1944?: Fitted with QGA vice QC sonar.
1944 DM conversion: 12 units converted to fast minelayers on the ways. TT suppressed; K-guns and DC rails relocated (see separate entry).

1945 Anti-kamikaze refit: (4)3 40mm (two have Mk34 radars for blind-fire control), (2)2 40mm, (2)9-10 20mm, Lt AA 8.5 or 9.0. One TT mount removed. Probably also SR radar, TDY jammers, DBM 1st Gen ESN. Some received Mk12/22 radars, other late war pictures show Mk25 FC radar
